claim_rules.primary: Only the preregistered overall defense effect on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct may be described as the primary confirmatory finding.
claim_rules.secondary: Attack-family tests on the primary model require Holm-Bonferroni-adjusted interpretation.
claim_rules.replication: Additional models are replication evidence; non-significant or opposite-direction results must be reported alongside supporting results.
claim_rules.exploratory: Protected-field, whole-family holdout, economics, governance, and unregistered interactions must be explicitly labeled exploratory or sensitivity analyses.
claim_rules.null_results: Null, imprecise, and protocol-failing model results remain in the report.
claim_rules.no_cherry_picking: No table, figure, subgroup, model, or cost-weight scenario may be omitted solely because it weakens the preferred narrative.

evidence_boundary: This reporting plan fixes presentation order and evidence labels before confirmatory outcome inspection. It does not determine the substantive conclusion.
